title: The Government Ghosted Cargill Too, Apparently

intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon government official character standing at a podium shaped like a soybean, nervously shuffling papers under a spotlight on a stand-up comedy stage.

outro_meme.prompt: The same government official now grinning wide, holding up a giant '+60%' sign like a game show host, confetti falling, pointing toward a glowing 'READ MORE' sign.

sources.fact: EPA's 2023 RFS final rule set biomass-based diesel volumes the American Farm Bureau Federation called 'short of expectations' relative to what the 2022 soy-crush capacity wave was built for.
EPA's April 2026 RFS rule raised biomass-based diesel volumes about 60% over 2025, explicitly citing 'renewed demand for domestic soybean production.'

lines.text: Kai, why the government keep playing with these soybean plants like a yo-yo?
